title: tanacetum abrotanifolium
intro: Tanacetum abrotanifolium, commonly known as Abrotanum or Sweet Marjoram, is a perennial herb in the daisy family that is native to Europe and Western Asia. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as wounds, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. Abrotanum's therapeutic actions include stimulating digestion, relieving flatulence, and soothing nervous disorders. The bioactive constituents of the plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been used in traditional medicine for centuries.
